46.title: Stateless DHCP server-Multiple Client in same interface (Dynamic entry)
46.description: The user will ensure that the Multiply Client can get info from DHCP server in same interface.
46.result:
DHCPv6 Client Send Information-request message to acquire configuration settings from DHCP server, the DHCP server will send Reply message(without IP address info, included requested configuration settings ).
All the DHCP clients sent can get correct info from DHCP server.

52.steps:
1.Set an interface such as X3 etc as LAN/DMZ Custom zone, set proper IPv6 address
2.Enable Enable Router Advertisement, enable Managed(M) Address Configuration and Other (O) Configuration flag and input proper value in Advanced page.
3.Go to DHCP server, choose IPv6, and add corresponding DHCP scope.
4.Using PC1 as DHCP client, connect to interface X3.
5.Set an interface such as X4 etc as LAN/DMZ Custom zone, set proper IPv6 address
6.Enable Enable Router Advertisement, only click Other (O) Configuration flag and input proper value in Advanced page.
7.Go to DHCP server, choose IPv6, and add corresponding DHCP scope.
8.Using PC2 as DHCP client, connect to interface X4.
9.Capture the packet between the client and server.
52.title: Mix stateless and stateful
52.description: The user will ensure that the Multiply Client can get info from DHCP server in same interface.
52.result:
1.As Stateful mode, capture packets from dhcpv6 server and dhcp client pc1, there is four message: solicit/advertise ,request/reply message exchanged. And the DHCP server sent IP info and other configuration settings to dhcp client.
2.In Stateless mode,DHCPv6 Client PC2 Send Information-request message to acquire configuration settings from DHCP server, the DHCP server will send Reply message(without IP address info, included requested configuration settings)
